description: This file is a Spring MVC controller for managing custom shipping methods, specifically weight-based shipping configurations in an e-commerce platform called Shopizer. It provides endpoints for adding, editing, deleting, and paginating custom shipping regions and prices, as well as loading related configuration data.

classes.name: CustomShippingMethodsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that manages custom weight-based shipping configurations, including regions and prices, for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles the GET request to display the weight-based shipping method configuration page.

methods.name: addCustomRegion
methods.description: Handles the POST request to add a new custom shipping region.

methods.name: addCountryToCustomRegion
methods.description: Associates a country with a specific custom shipping region.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Saves updates to the shipping module configuration.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country from a shipping region via AJAX.

methods.name: deletePrice
methods.description: Removes a weight-price entry from a region via AJAX.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Deletes the entire custom shipping weight-based method configuration.

methods.name: checkRegionCode
methods.description: Checks if a region code already exists to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: pageCustomShipping
methods.description: Provides paginated listing of shipping regions and countries.

methods.name: pageCustomShippingDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed paginated list of weight-based quotes within a region.

methods.name: editCustomShipping
methods.description: Edits an existing custom shipping region.

methods.name: addPrice
methods.description: Adds a new weight and price entry to a shipping region.
